description.p: A human studies the flow of battle, watching sparks fade against stone and steel trace its familiar arcs. With a deliberate stroke through the air, she fixes the moment in place, and flame follows the path she has chosen.
Crouched behind cover, a half-elf measures distance and motion before releasing a wash of numbing cold, reshaping the field long enough for his allies to press the attack.
An Artist stands within the chaos, tools in hand, applying force and color with intention. Each choice is deliberate. Each action builds toward a greater work.

Artists are spellcasters who treat the world as a canvas. Rather than relying on overwhelming spellcasting, they shape magic through discipline, precision, and commitment. By establishing a canvas in the world and working upon it step by step, an Artist creates effects that resolve the battle according to their vision.

Though their magic is narrower than that of other casters, Artists excel at controlling space and momentum. Their greatest works demand focus and patience, while practiced techniques keep them effective even as a larger composition takes form.
Whatever their origin, all Artists share the same belief: magic, like art, is strongest when guided by intent.
Artists are adventurers first and foremost. Their power does not come from vast reserves of magic, but from a practiced ability to respond to the moment before them.
Through passion, discipline, and an eye for opportunity, they shape the world in small but meaningful ways, turning chaos into composition.
Artists are often regarded with a mixture of curiosity and unease. Their work is difficult to explain, their methods stranger still.
For an Artist, chaos is not a hazard to be avoided, but a medium to be explored.
When creating an Artist, consider the experiences and passions that shaped their approach to magic.
Make Wisdom your highest ability score, followed by Dexterity or Constitution. Choose a background such as Artisan Guild, Entertainer, Hermit, or Sage.

ul.li: Hit Points at 1st Level: 6 + your Constitution modifier
Hit Points at Higher Levels: 1d6 (or 4) + your Constitution modifier per artist level after 1st
Tools: Calligrapher’s supplies or painter’s supplies
Skills: Choose two from Arcana, History, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, and Religion

description.p: You start with the following equipment, in addition to the equipment granted by your background:

ul.li: An infused brush, which functions as your spellcasting focus
(a) an explorer’s pack or (b) a scholar’s pack

sheet.description: A deliberate spellcaster who builds power through composition, control, and execution.

setters.set: A spellcasting creator who shapes reality through palettes, Studies, and Artworks.
